svg.aria-label: Glance answers many questions about one image in one forward pass, returning typed decisions: a box, yes or no, a choice, or a calibrated not there. A typical VLM decodes free text token by token for every question; Glance stops after prefill and reads every answer from heads.

path.aria-label: Ask an image many questions. Get typed decisions in one pass.
Vision-Decision builds Glance: a 4B VLM for agents that look at screens, photos and video.
writes free text, then parses it
done. Every answer is read from heads.
